products.name: CoolGuard
products.shortDescription: Maintains temperature stability for 48-96 hours at different temperature ranges

description.text: Easy to use, reliable packaging solutions with PCM refrigerants

The cube shaped CoolGuard solutions with PCM refrigerants are easy to use, which makes the packing process run smoother. The PCM elements keep the temperature inside the packaging at the desired level, regardless of outside temperatures.
CoolGuard PCM shippers maintain temperature stability for 48-96 hours with payload volumes from 6 to 96 litres.

CoolGuard Advanced have vacuum panels that ensure that the products you’re shipping are kept at the correct temperature, which allows for longer, more time consuming transports. CoolGuard Advanced secure products at -18 degrees C, from +2° to +8° and from +15° to + 25°.

CoolGuard PCM have industry leading payload to external volume ratios, reducing storage and distribution costs. This means that despite higher packaging price, the total cost will probably be lower. CoolGuard’s lower weight often means that shipping costs can be reduced, compared to the Sherpa solution.
CoolGuard is robust and can be reused several times. The components can then be recycled or disposed in a waste stream, making CoolGuard a sustainable choice.

description.text: Durable, lightweight packaging for different temperature ranges
Crédo Cube protects your payload and keeps it at just the right temperature for up to five days.

Crédo Cube is available in a wide array of sizes, from 3 to 96 litres and temperature ranges including controlled room temperature, refrigerated and deep-frozen. It’s the ideal solution when you need a steady temperature inside the packaging, especially when delays may occur.
The durable cube has a simple design with a few components that make it easy to pack and unpack. It can also be reused over and over again.
Crédo Cube Series 4: keeps the inner temperature at +2 to +8°C
Crédo Cube Series 22: keeps the inner temperature at +15 to +25°C
Crédo Cube Series 22 Universal: made for more demanding transports, where outside temperatures may change, but with an inside temperature of 15 to 25°C.
Crédo Cube Series 20M: keeps the inner temperature at -15 to -25°C
Crédo Cube Series 20M: keeps the inner temperature at -40°C or colder

products.name: BEWI Pallet
products.shortDescription: The sustainable pallet system for the future

description.text: The sustainable alternative that helps reduce CO2 emissions

BEWI Pallets are designed to transport EPS Fish boxes – but will revolutionize more than the way Seafood is transported. By eliminating manual re-stacking, BEWI pallets will decrease air cargo preparation time by 70%. This also reduces the danger of breakage and keeps fish and other food better preserved, which lowers food waste.
The BEWI pallet also reduces inbound shipping costs and the CO2 footprint of pallets due to stackability and almost the double number of pallets per truck.
The BEWI pallet provides an extra 175 kg per PMC (7 boxes of 25 kg), reducing your CO2 footprint by approximately 5%. The reduced PMC also means fewer cargo planes are required.

The pallets have round corners, so no dirt gets stuck, and there aren’t any closed spaces that can crack and gather bacteria. The pallets can be easily cleaned and washed for reuse, lending themselves to use with food, beverages, and other products where contamination must be minimized.
The low weight is spread on 24 pallet legs and the upper side have non-slip rails.
The BEWI pallet contributes to the circular economy as it’s 100% recyclable and can be reused again and again.
